the CD in indoor OWC channels is typically on the order of tens of centimeters, which is significantly shorter than the typical room dimension.
the average CD is a measure of the average spatial distance over which a channel does not change.

the CD is an important parameter for the design and performance analysis of OWC systems, and it should be considered when designing OWC systems.
